# Running the Machine {.unnumbered}

\lettrine{B}{uilding} a physical AI machine is fundamentally an exercise in **reconciling disparate timescales, representations, and failure domains**.

No single algorithm, neural model, or silicon core can span the vast continuum between high-level human reasoning and low-level physical dynamics. At the deliberative tier, human intent and task semantics are linguistic and symbolic, evolving over seconds ($0.1\text{--}1\text{ Hz}$). In the middle tier, physical space is continuous and metric, requiring 3D spatial representations and smooth kinematic trajectories generated at tens of hertz ($20\text{--}50\text{ Hz}$). At the execution tier, motor torque control is electromagnetic and immediate, demanding cycle-deterministic execution at kilohertz frequencies ($1000\text{ Hz}$) on bare-metal silicon to prevent mechanical resonance and kinetic destruction.

Part III details **The Living Organism: The Millisecond Pipeline** that transforms raw physical sensor photons into coordinated motor currents:

* **From Photons to Spatial Claims (Chapter 8: Perception):** How raw, uncompressed sensor streams from SerDes lanes are ingested via DMA ring buffers, corrected for rolling-shutter distortion, calibrated against IMUs, and lifted into calibrated metric $SE(3)$ spatial claims under strict information-age budgets.
* **Preserving Belief Under Occlusion (Chapter 9: Memory):** How spatial representations (transform trees, TSDF voxel grids, 3D Gaussian Splats) persist when objects pass behind obstacles or cameras pan away, enforcing explicit temporal decay rates to prevent "frozen transform" collisions.
* **From Semantic Goals to Reachable Affordances (Chapter 10: Intent):** How open-vocabulary foundation models decompose human language into spatial affordances, issuing cryptographically bounded, expiring **Intent Leases** with hard time-to-live (TTL) envelopes that fail-safe on silence.
* **Synthesizing Continuous Motion (Chapter 11: Planning):** How continuous generative models predict $H$-step action chunks, smooth kinematic transitions across chunk boundaries using $C^2$ jerk splines, and guarantee safe stopping suffixes when upstream inference experiences latency spikes.
* **The Deterministic Gatekeeper (Chapter 12: Enforcement):** The bare-metal 1 kHz safety shield. We implement Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) and quadratic programming (QP) projection on dedicated microcontrollers, enforcing the Four-Tier Fallback Ladder and the Simplex Architecture Pattern to retain exclusive veto authority over power stages.
* **The Silicon Substrate (Chapter 13: Placement):** How high-throughput neural deliberation and hard-real-time safety co-exist on shared heterogeneous System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms. We quantify on-chip memory crossbar QoS, DRAM bank contention, power distribution network ($L \frac{dI}{dt}$) voltage droop, and hysteretic thermal clock throttling.

Part III teaches students how to architect, synchronize, and isolate the six computational stages that keep high-level machine intelligence grounded in physical reality.
